title: QA Automation Engineer
tagline: Make quality automatic: test strategies, frameworks and pipelines.
about: QA and test automation engineers make sure software works before users find out otherwise. You'll design test strategies, build automated test suites across the UI, API and performance layers, and wire them into CI so every change is checked.
It's a strong entry point into engineering with clear progression to SDET, platform or development roles.
day: Write automated UI and API tests
Design test plans for new features
Maintain test frameworks and CI pipelines
Investigate flaky tests and production bugs

phases.title: Programming foundations
phases.goal: Write small programs confidently and use the tools every developer uses daily.

nodes.d: Pick JavaScript and get fluent with the basics before anything else. Fluency in one language transfers to every other.
links: CS50x: Harvard's intro to computer science

nodes.d: Developers live in the command line: navigating files, running programs and chaining tools together.
links: The Missing Semester of Your CS Education (MIT)
OverTheWire: Bandit (learn the shell by playing)

nodes.d: Version control is non-negotiable: every job uses it. Commit early, branch for experiments, open pull requests.
Break problems down, read errors calmly, use a debugger and print statements deliberately.
links: Exercism: practice in 70+ languages with mentoring

nodes.d: What to test, how much, and at which level.
links: ISTQB: software testing certifications and syllabi

nodes.d: Check data directly and set up test states.
End-to-end tests with reliable locators and waits.
Fast, stable tests below the UI.
Work with developers on tests closest to the code.
Run tests on every change with useful reports.

project.d: A Playwright + API test suite for a public demo app, with page objects, test data setup, CI runs on every push and an HTML report.

nodes.d: Load and stress tests with clear goals.
Keep services compatible without full end-to-end runs.
Metrics and processes that improve quality team-wide.

interview: Design a test plan for a feature (for example a login page).
Write a UI or API test live.
Explain the test pyramid and flaky-test fixes.
certs: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (common in some regions)
